verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs directly describe an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage flags, preview drafts, and inspect performance (vercel-docs-7). Comments work on both preview and production environments, which covers the live site (vercel-docs-8), and comments can be converted to GitHub, Jira, or Linear issues (vercel-intdir-7/8/9); a Flags SDK integration also exists (vercel-intdir-11). Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the toolbar's flag-management and performance-inspection features (each is only a one-line mention), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
